definitions.ask: Should BY_MACHINE status subgroups also split out a Monitoring subgroup?
definitions.why: Docs say BY_MACHINE reuses the BY_STATUS groups, and one helper keeps patch signatures simple

choices.label: BY_MACHINE status subgroups gain Monitoring too, via the shared status_bucket_for helper
Only BY_STATUS splits out Monitoring; BY_MACHINE keeps it under Running via a second helper

definitions.ask: Should a clan row that mirrors its lone monitoring member also move into Monitoring?
definitions.why: The group then always matches the status word the clan row already shows

choices.label: A clan row joins Monitoring whenever it shows its lone member's live monitor label
Clan rows stay in Running, so monitoring sessions inside clans never appear there

definitions.ask: Should Monitoring sit directly after Running in the BY_STATUS order?
definitions.why: A running monitor is live work, so it sits beside Running, above not-yet-started work

choices.label: Order becomes Stopped, Failed, Running, Monitoring, Queued, Waiting, Done, Starting
Order becomes Stopped, Failed, Running, Queued, Waiting, Monitoring, Done, Starting
